screen25-f1.location: top-left of a new-course setup question
screen25-f1.convention_relied_on: a left arrow is the established back convention — confidence high
screen25-f1.context_reading: top-left of a new-course setup question

test_cases.precondition: app open on a screen carrying the member; screen allowed to settle; prior sheets closed
test_cases.action: note the on-screen context, then tap each live instance of the control in turn (every capture of the same live control is tapped as that control, in each distinct state it was captured in)
test_cases.confirms_if: two members in the same visual state do unrelated things and nothing visible before the tap says so
test_cases.overturns_if: every member does the same thing, or the difference is a state face or the same job scoped to its own page
test_cases.observed_result: returns to the previous setup step (from the first course question to "What would you like to learn?")

screen25-f2.location: full-width button at the foot of a new-course setup question
screen25-f2.context_reading: full-width button at the foot of a new-course setup question
screen25-f2.observed_function: grey and unresponsive until an answer is picked; then green, and advances to the next setup step
